entries.text: You see a man in studded leather armor with an odd assortment of knick-knacks.
entries.source_text:
You see a man in studded leather armor with an odd assortment of
 knick-knacks.

entries.text: You see Patrick, the Celt.
entries.source_text: You see Patrick, the Celt.

entries.text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you out this far?
entries.source_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you out this far?

entries.text: Just wandering.
entries.source_text: Just wandering.

entries.text: Um, why are you carrying all that junk?
entries.source_text: Um, why are you carrying all that junk?

entries.text: I need to find a water purification control chip.
entries.source_text: I need to find a water purification control chip.

entries.text: I'm killing everybody I can get within shooting distance of. Prepare to die.
entries.source_text: I'm killing everybody I can get within shooting distance of. Prepare to die.

entries.text: Lub!
entries.source_text: Lub!

entries.text: I see. Much like myself, then.
entries.source_text: I see. Much like myself, then.

entries.text: Oh? You're not from one of the communities out here?
entries.source_text: Oh? You're not from one of the communities out here?

entries.text: Can you direct me to a nearby settlement?
entries.source_text: Can you direct me to a nearby settlement?

entries.text: So what's your story?
entries.source_text: So what's your story?

entries.text: Well, see ya.
entries.source_text: Well, see ya.

entries.text: It's not junk! It's trade goods!
entries.source_text: It's not junk! It's trade goods!

entries.text: Uh, right. Bye.
entries.source_text: Uh, right. Bye.

entries.text: Uh huh. So what's your story?
entries.source_text: Uh huh. So what's your story?

entries.text: Hmm. Haven't seen one of those before. What seems to be the trouble?
entries.source_text: Hmm. Haven't seen one of those before. What seems to be the trouble?

entries.text: This chip controls water purification for my Vault. It's blown out, though.
entries.source_text: This chip controls water purification for my Vault. It's blown out, though.

entries.text: It's broken.
entries.source_text: It's broken.

entries.text: I wander from place to place, making a living with music and a little bit of tinkering work.
entries.source_text:
I wander from place to place, making a living with music and a little bit
 of tinkering work.

entries.text: What kind of work do you do?
entries.source_text: What kind of work do you do?

entries.text: What kind of music do you sing?
entries.source_text: What kind of music do you sing?

entries.text: Well, it's good to meet you. Bye.
entries.source_text: Well, it's good to meet you. Bye.

entries.text: Using the coastline as a referent, you've got Shady Sands about a week inland, and Junktown a few days south of there. Hub's just another couple days south of Junktown. Avoid Necropolis to the east of those, though. Not worth the trouble.
entries.source_text:
Using the coastline as a referent, you've got Shady Sands about a week
 inland, and Junktown a few days south of there. Hub's just another couple days
 south of Junktown. Avoid Necropolis to the east of those, though. Not worth
 the trouble.

entries.text: What do you know about Shady Sands?
entries.source_text: What do you know about Shady Sands?

entries.text: What do you know about Junktown?
entries.source_text: What do you know about Junktown?

entries.text: What do you know about the Hub?
entries.source_text: What do you know about the Hub?

entries.text: What do you know about Necropolis?
entries.source_text: What do you know about Necropolis?

entries.text: I don't think I could help you with that. I never had much of a chance to study pre-war Vault technology.
entries.source_text:
I don't think I could help you with that. I never had much of a chance to
 study pre-war Vault technology.

entries.text: Mostly a little electrical and mechanical tinkering. I helped Junktown with their lights and showed the people in Shady Sands a better design for their stoves.
entries.source_text:
Mostly a little electrical and mechanical tinkering. I helped Junktown with
 their lights and showed the people in Shady Sands a better design for their
 stoves.

entries.text: Really? Think you could fix a water chip?
entries.source_text: Really? Think you could fix a water chip?

entries.text: Oh, mostly old folk songs and some Celtic music. It's a change of pace.
entries.source_text: Oh, mostly old folk songs and some Celtic music. It's a change of pace.

entries.text: Would you happen to know "Na Gheala Mbeadh", as I think it's called?
entries.source_text: Would you happen to know "Na Gheala Mbeadh", as I think it's called?

entries.text: I see. What else do you do?
entries.source_text: I see. What else do you do?

entries.text: Shady Sands is a small, self-sufficient community led by Aradesh, a kind man and strong leader. They are peaceful and hard-working. They are probably the best chance for a new civilization here.
entries.source_text:
Shady Sands is a small, self-sufficient community led by Aradesh, a kind
 man and strong leader. They are peaceful and hard-working. They are probably the
 best chance for a new civilization here.

entries.text: Shady Sands is a small farming community. They were led by a good man named Aradesh, but I've heard he's gone. It's a pity. Without him I don't know if they'll survive.
entries.source_text:
Shady Sands is a small farming community. They were led by a good man
 named Aradesh, but I've heard he's gone. It's a pity. Without him I don't know
 if they'll survive.

entries.text: Junktown? A small trading city. Strange place until you get used to it. They are run by mayor Killian Darkwater, a hard but fair man.
entries.source_text:
Junktown? A small trading city. Strange place until you get used to it.
 They are run by mayor Killian Darkwater, a hard but fair man.

entries.text: Junktown? A small trading city. Strange place until you get used to it. They are run by Gizmo, a gambling mogul and crime-lord.
entries.source_text:
Junktown? A small trading city. Strange place until you get used to it.
 They are run by Gizmo, a gambling mogul and crime-lord.

entries.text: Junktown? A small trading city. Not too remarkable.
entries.source_text: Junktown? A small trading city. Not too remarkable.

entries.text: The Hub is a major trading center. It's said that you can find anything there, and I'd say that's not too far wrong.
entries.source_text:
The Hub is a major trading center. It's said that you can find anything
 there, and I'd say that's not too far wrong.

entries.text: Necropolis is the city of the dead. It's inhabited by ghouls, the descendants of humans who sought shelter in a Vault there. Story goes that the Vault failed somehow, so now the only inhabitants are carrion-eating monsters.
entries.source_text:
Necropolis is the city of the dead. It's inhabited by ghouls, the
 descendants of humans who sought shelter in a Vault there. Story goes that the
 Vault failed somehow, so now the only inhabitants are carrion-eating monsters.

entries.text: It was overrun by an army of mutants last I heard. I'd stay away from there, if I were you.
entries.source_text:
It was overrun by an army of mutants last I heard. I'd stay away from
 there, if I were you.

entries.text: Do you suppose that Vault might have parts that I could salvage?
entries.source_text: Do you suppose that Vault might have parts that I could salvage?

entries.text: Possibly, but I for one wouldn't risk the ghouls. Latest word is they've some sort of powerful new leader.
entries.source_text:
Possibly, but I for one wouldn't risk the ghouls. Latest word is they've
 some sort of powerful new leader.

entries.text: Why, certainly. Would you like to hear it?
entries.source_text: Why, certainly. Would you like to hear it?

entries.text: Sure.
entries.source_text: Sure.

entries.text: Nah.
entries.source_text: Nah.

entries.text: [Patrick sings songs and the two of you reminisce for several hours. You feel invigorated.]
entries.source_text:
[Patrick sings songs and the two of you reminisce for several hours. You
 feel invigorated.]

entries.text: Hello again. Can I help you?
entries.source_text: Hello again. Can I help you?

entries.text: Yeah, can you give me some directions?
entries.source_text: Yeah, can you give me some directions?

entries.text: No, never mind, thanks.
entries.source_text: No, never mind, thanks.
